# Format Size

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Formats the size of a file.

## Syntax

~~~~text
formatSize(size: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>, format: <#Enumeration (WFFileSizeFormat)#>, units: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
formatSize(size: 32324241424, format: Gigabytes, units: false)
~~~~
